why: The installed aegis-core plugin shipped 9 skills and NO `pma` entry, so `/pma` was never a real slash command -- the premarket card only ever ran by hand, executed straight from the repo. This build adds it. PM, 2026-08-19: 'package and commit the FUCKING SKILL then. I dont want things in a container and loss.'
change: ADD skills/pma/ (no existing skill touched; the other 9 ship byte-identical)

pma_payload.note: frontmatter `name: pma` is what makes /pma trigger

source_of_truth_rule: The REPO is source of truth, never the bundled copy. SKILL.md's own rule is 'fetch fresh from main every run -- never a cached copy'. The bundled tools/stages/contracts are an OFFLINE FALLBACK so a run can proceed if GitHub is unreachable. On any disagreement main wins, and S6B_post_committee.md wins over SKILL.md.
rebuild_recipe: 4. curl each file in pma_payload[] from raw.githubusercontent.com/TongIncomeWheel/AQE/main/<from_repo>
6. Write skills/pma/README.md stating the source-of-truth rule above
8. Deliver the .plugin to the PM; it is installed from the chat, not written to disk by the agent
verification_performed: SKILL.md contains 'S6.8 . PM LENS', 'v4.4 operational card', and the Q7L gate family
python3 -m py_compile passed on both bundled tools
archive lists all 5 pma payload files at their expected byte sizes; 147 files total
known_gap: aegis-core is a GENERATED plugin ('Generated; do not hand-edit'), produced from the kernel via aegis/packaging/build_claude.py. This build was assembled by copying the installed plugin and adding skills/pma/, NOT by re-running the generator. The next kernel regeneration will DROP skills/pma unless the generator itself is taught to emit it. That is the durable fix and it is not done -- tracked here so the loss is predictable rather than silent.
